entries.rationale: CA students enrolled at least half-time in a degree or certificate program at CCC/CSU/UC qualify automatically under the LPIE expansion. TODO: replace with actual CA CDSS ACL number (Matthew to provide).
entries.en: Enrolled at least half-time in a degree or certificate program at a CA Community College, CSU, or UC. You meet the student exemption automatically.
entries.es: Inscrito al menos medio tiempo en un programa de grado o certificado en CCC, CSU o UC. Cumple la exención estudiantil automáticamente.
